title: sc:troubleshoot pipeline-hardening catch-rate report
description: Schema for `catch-rate.json` emitted by the E1-E5 differential backtest harness. Producer: `tests.troubleshoot.backtest.catch_rate.CatchRateReport.to_dict()`. Writer: `catch_rate_report.write_catch_rate_report`. Drives NFR-1 `backtest_status`. The anti-vacuity derivation (all-5-CATCH AND each with negative_witness AND non-null card_path -> complete) is enforced in `CatchRateReport.__post_init__`, not by this schema; the schema documents the required field shape + enums.

run_id.description: Opaque identifier stamped on the backtest run.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 wall-clock timestamp marking report generation.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the catch-rate output contract.

total_escapes.description: Number of escape records (the catch_rate denominator). 5 for a full E1-E5 run; 0 for a not_run report. The waiver-re-green meta-scenario is EXCLUDED (it backs NFR-4, not NFR-1).

caught.description: Count of escapes with verdict CATCH.

missed.description: Count of escapes with verdict MISS.

proxy_limitation.description: REQUIRED serialized note recording that NEW=CATCH is a documentation-presence proxy (so it cannot be dropped from the artifact / oversold). minLength 1 makes it required-HONEST, not merely required-present: an empty caveat cannot ship in the JSON SoT.

backtestStatus.description: RELEASE-SPEC sec 4.5 backtest_status enum. Default not_run.

escapeId.description: This schema's OWN escape-id pattern (E1..E5). Declared fresh here; NOT reused from summary.schema.json, which carries no escape-id/eval-id pattern $def.

wave.description: The H-wave (e.g. H1..H4) the escape maps to in RELEASE-SPEC sec 8.3.

verdict.description: CATCH = new H-gate would catch; MISS = not proven caught.

negative_witness.description: True iff the OLD=MISS negative witness was observed for this escape.

card_path.description: Path to the NEW=CATCH proof surface (impl-ref card); null until impl refs land. A null card_path blocks complete (anti-vacuity).

detail.description: Human-readable note on the observed differential.
